exercises.text: At standard atmospheric pressure and a temperature of $20^\circ\mathrm{C}$, which contains more molecules: the air in a room of volume $50$ m$^3$, or the water in a glass holding $200$ cm$^3$ of water?

exercises.text: Modern vacuum pumps can reduce pressure to $1.3\times10^{-10}$ N/m$^2$, approximately $10^{-12}$ mm of mercury. At this pressure and a temperature of $27^\circ\mathrm{C}$, how many gas molecules are contained in $1$ cm$^3$?
